ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. has increased its stake in its subsidiary, JC Biotech Private Limited, from 96.94% to 98.16% by acquiring an additional 1.22% for ₹22.80 million. This acquisition is a strategic step towards making JC Biotech a Wholly Owned Subsidiary, with the company actively pursuing the remaining 1.84% stake to fully consolidate operations and simplify future financial reporting. No red flags are indicated by this routine consolidation activity.
